DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、先ほど文房具のカタログを一生懸命に読んでたけれど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何か必要なものでもあるのかい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 新しいペン立てを注文しようと思って

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういった単純な形状なら、うちで作った方が早いと思うよ。どうかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんな簡単に作れるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もちろん。おまけに市販のものよりもっと軽くて丈夫なものをね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょうど材料もあるから、私の方で作ってみようか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、じゃあお願いしようかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 分かった、じゃあ1時間後ぐらいにエンジニア部の作業室に来てほしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、シャーレのトイレの電気が切れたみたいだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: スイッチを押したのに、明かりが点かなかった

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あ、そうなんだ、ありがとう。修理業者を呼ばないと……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫、電線が切れただけみたいだから、簡単に直せるはず

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 圧着工具はどこかな？私が直すよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんな専門的な工具は、シャーレにはないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……無いのかい？ひとつも？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……そうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、予定通り今日の午後は当番でシャーレに伺うよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ごめん、急な予定が入って、午後シャーレにいないかも

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうなのか。いや、それは仕方ない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何か先生がいない間に、やっておくべきことはあるかい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 午後に宅配が届くかもしれないから、受け取ってくれる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 宅配？どんなものが？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 犬のロボットを注文してて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: へえ、犬のロボットか……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……念のためだけど、解剖しちゃダメだよ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……ウタハ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、この前頼まれた自転車の修理が終わったから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度ミレニアムに来た時に、エンジニア部に寄って受け取ってくれるかい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すごい、早いね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 流石、ミレニアムのマイスター！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあ、私でなくてもこのくらいなら、それほど難しい修理ではないさ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生も今度、自分で修理してみたらきっと分かるよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: むしろ、ウタハが修理するところを隣で見てたいな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それは、どうなんだろうな……作業室には、危険なものも多いからね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それに、修理は単純作業の繰り返しだ。あまり面白いものでは無いと思うよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大人しくしてるから～

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そんな子供みたいに……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どちらにせよ今は修理するものもないから……またの機会にね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そういえばさっき駐輪場で、雷ちゃんがひとりでに変な動きしてたよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なっ、雷ちゃんが！？！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 「サーバル」から今度、新しい作業用手袋が発売されるらしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 以前買った「マナスル」のは少々厚すぎたから、良いタイミングだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そういえばウタハ、屋内でもずっと手袋を着けてるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何かマイスター的に特別な理由があるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大した理由ではないけど、私の指はあまり人に見せられたものではないから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 昔からずっと油と金属を触ってきたせいで、決して綺麗とは言えない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから、ね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日、時間はあるかい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だよ。何かあったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと工具を新調しようと思って

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私が贔屓にしてる工具専門店があるんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生さえ良ければ、紹介しようかなと

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 喜んで！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 아까 보니 도매 문구점의 카탈로그를 열심히 읽고 있던데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 새로 필요한 학용품이라도 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 새 연필꽂이를 주문하려고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 연필꽂이처럼 단순한 형태의 가구라면 부실에 있는 3D 프린터로 만드는 게 더 빠르지 않겠어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 3D 프린터로도 연필꽂이를 만들 수 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 물론이야. 게다가 시중에 있는 제품보다 더 가볍고 튼튼하게 만들 수 있다고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 재료도 마침 있는데, 한번 만들어 볼까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응, 그럼 부탁할게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 알았어. 그럼 1시간 정도 뒤에 엔지니어부의 작업실로 찾아와.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 샬레 하우스의 화장실 불이 나간 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 스위치 버튼을 눌러봤는데 불이 들어오지 않더라고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그래? 수리 기사를 불러야겠네…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮아. 전선이 끊어진 것뿐이니 간단하게 고칠 수 있어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 전선 슬리브 압착기는 어디에 있어? 내가 수리할게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 전문적인 공구는 샬레에 없는데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……샬레에 압착기가 한 자루도 없다고?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……정말?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 오늘 오후 당번 학생 활동도 잘 부탁해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 미안. 갑작스러운 출장 일정이 잡혀서 오후에는 샬레에 없을 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래? 그렇다면 어쩔 수 없지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 선생님이 없는 동안 해두어야 할 일이라도 있을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 오후에 택배가 하나 도착할 텐데 나 대신 받아줘.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 택배?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 샬레의 놀이방에 둘 장난감 강아지 인형을 하나 주문했거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 헤에, 장난감 강아지 인형이라…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……혹시나 해서 말해두는 건데, 구조가 궁금하다고 먼저 뜯어보면 안 된다?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……우타하?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 지난번에 부탁했던 자전거 바퀴의 수리가 모두 끝났어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다음에 밀레니엄 학원에 올 때 엔지니어부 부실에 들러서 찾아가.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 생각보다 빨리 끝났네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 역시 밀레니엄의 마이스터야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 내가 아니더라도 이 정도의 고장을 수리하는 건 어려운 일이 아니니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님도 나중에 직접 수리해보면 알게 될 거야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 우타하가 물건을 수리하는 모습을 옆에서 직접 보고 싶은데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……그건 곤란해. 엔지니어부의 작업실에는 위험한 물건이 많거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 게다가 수리라는 건 단순 작업의 반복이라, 옆에서 지켜봐도 별 재미도 없다고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 얌전히 있을 테니까 제발~.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어린 아이도 아니잖아. 떼쓰지 마.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어차피 지금은 딱히 수리할 물건도 없으니까…… 나중에 기회가 생기면 다시 말해줄게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 아까 자전거 보관소에서 봤는데 천둥이가 혼자 엎어져서 헛돌고 있던데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 천둥이가?!?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: <서벌>에서 새로운 작업용 장갑을 출시하려는 모양이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지난번에 <마나슬루>에서 구입한 장갑은 너무 두꺼워서 새로운 것을 찾던 중이었는데…… 마침 잘 되었네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 우타하는 실내에서도 언제나 작업용 장갑을 끼고 있네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 특별한 이유라도 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 특별한 이유라고 할 것은 없고…… 내 손가락은 그다지 예쁜 편이 아니거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어릴 적부터 기름과 금속을 만지고 살았더니 끝이 갈라지고 기름때가 스며들어서 보기에 흉해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 장갑을 끼고 다니는 것뿐이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 오늘 시간 괜찮을까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮은데, 무슨 일이야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그냥 공구를 좀 사러 갈 일이 있어서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나만 아는 공구 전문점이 있는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮으면, 소개해 줄까 해서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 얼마든지!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I saw you reading through the wholesale stationary shop's catalog before...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is there something you need?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I want to order some new pencil holders.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If it's something as simple as a pencil holder, isn't it faster just to make it through the 3D printer in the club room?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You can make a pencil holder with a 3D printer?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Of course! And it should be lighter and stronger than most products on the market.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I even have the materials. Should I make one for you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That would be great.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay! Come to the Engineering Department workshop in about an hour.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I think the light bulb went out in the bathroom at the Schale office, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I flipped the switch, but nothing happened.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Really? I should call a repairman.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's okay. The wires are just disconnected, so it's an easy fix.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Where do you keep the wire compression sleeves? I'll fix it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: We don't have anything like that at Schale...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Schale doesn't have a single compression sleeve?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Really?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I'm counting on you to schedule the student activities this afternoon.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sorry, I have to leave town, so I won't be at Schale this afternoon.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Really? Well, I guess there's nothing I can do about it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is there anything I should get done while you're gone?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I have a package coming this afternoon. Maybe you can grab it for me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What kind of package?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I ordered a toy dog for Schale's playroom.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee. A toy dog...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Um... You probably wouldn't anyway, but please don't open the package, okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Utaha?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, the bicycle wheel is all fixed.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Drop by the Engineering Department office the next time you're at the Millennium School.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That was faster than I expected.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'd expect nothing less from a meister of Millennium!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This is a piece of cake for anyone at Millennium.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You'll see when you do it yourself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I want to watch you while you work...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can't let you do that. The Engineering Department workshop is filled with dangerous objects.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And since a simple fix like this is just a bunch of repetition, it won't be any fun to watch.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll be right here...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're not a little kid. Don't push it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's nothing really to fix right now... I'll let you know next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I passed by the bicycle storage and saw Thundergun toppled over.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What? Thundergun?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It looks like Serval is going to release some new work gloves.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The gloves I bought from Manaslu are too thick, so I was looking for something new. Perfect timing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I notice you always wear work gloves, even when you're inside, Utaha.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Can I ask why?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No special reason... My fingers aren't very pretty.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Since I spent my childhood playing with grease and metal, my fingers are all cut up and calloused.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That's why I'm always wearing gloves.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you free today by any chance?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sure. What's up?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I just need to go buy some tools.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's a secret little hardware store I go to.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was wondering if you'd like to join me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'd love to!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เมื่อกี๊ฉันเห็นคุณครูอ่านแคตตาล็อกขาย
ส่งของร้านเครื่องเขียนอย่างตั้งใจมากเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีอุปกรณ์การสอนที่อยากซื้องั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ว่าจะซื้อที่ใส่ดินสอหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ของง่ายๆ อย่างที่ใส่ดินสอนี้ใช้เครื่อง
พิมพ์สามมิติทำเอาไม่เร็วกว่าเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ทำที่ใส่ดินสอจากเครื่องพิมพ์สาม
มิติได้ด้วยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ทำได้สิ แถมยังออกมาเบาและแข็งแรง
กว่าที่ขายในร้านเครื่องเขียนซะอีก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันมีวัสดุอยู่พอดี ลองทำดูมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ดีเลย งั้นครูฝากด้วยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้ หนึ่งชั่วโมงหลังจากนี้ก็แวะมาเอาที่
ห้องปฏิบัติงานของชมรมวิศวกรรมนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ฉันว่าไฟในห้องน้ำของชาเล่ต์
ต้องเสียแน่ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
กดสวิทช์ตั้งหลายครั้งแล้ว แต่ไฟก็ไม่
ติดเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ไฟเสียเหรอ?
งั้นต้องเรียกช่างมาซ่อม...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่เป็นไรหรอก แค่สายไฟถูกตัดเอง
เราซ่อมมันเองได้ง่ายๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีคีมปอกสายไฟมั้ย? เดี๋ยวฉันซ่อมเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ชาเล่ต์ไม่มีอุปกรณ์แบบนั้นหรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ที่ชาเล่ต์ไม่มีคีมซักอันเลยเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จริงเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู เย็นนี้ฝากกิจกรรมตัวแทนนักเรียน
ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ขอโทษนะ ครูมีงานด่วนเข้ามาน่ะ
ตอนเย็นคงจะไม่ได้อยู่ที่ชาเล่ต์

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งานด่วนเหรอ? ถ้างั้นก็ช่วยไม่ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มีเรื่องอะไรให้ฉันทำระหว่างที่คุณครูไม่
อยู่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ช่วงเย็นจะมีพัสดุเข้ามาส่ง
เธอช่วยรับไว้หน่อยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พัสดุอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูสั่งตุ๊กตาน้องหมาไว้น่ะ ว่าจะเอา
มาวางในห้องนั่งเล่นของชาเล่ต์

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตุ๊กตา... น้องหมาเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ขอบอกไว้ก่อนนะ
เธอห้ามแกะดูของก่อนเด็ดขาด

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อุทาฮะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ฉันซ่อมล้อจักรยานที่ขอให้ช่วย
คราวก่อนเสร็จหมดแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คราวหน้าถ้ามาโรงเรียนมิลเลเนียมก็แวะ
ไปเอาที่ห้องชมรมวิศวกรรมนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เสร็จเร็วกว่าที่คิดอีกแฮะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สมกับเป็นไมสเตอร์แห่งมิลเลเนียม!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ชมอะไรขนาดนั้น งานซ่อมแบบนี้ไม่ใช่
เรื่องยากหรอกนะ คนอื่นก็ทำได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้คุณครูลองซ่อมดูเองก็จะรู้ว่าไม่ยากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ครูอยากนั่งดูอุทาฮะซ่อมของ
นู่นนี่นี่นา...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ได้หรอก... เพราะในห้องชมรม
วิศวกรรมมีของอันตรายเยอะเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อีกอย่างงานซ่อมก็ไม่ได้สนุกขนาดนั้นด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะนั่งเฉยๆ น่า~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตื๊อเหมือนเด็กเลย อายุเท่าไหร่แล้วเนี่ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนนี้ไม่มีอะไรให้ซ่อมหรอก... ต่อไป
หากต้องซ่อมอะไรฉันจะบอกเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
จะว่าไป เมื่อกี้เหมือนเห็นเจ้าสายฟ้า
ล้มลงไปหมุนอยู่ในที่เก็บจักรยานเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าไงนะ เจ้าสายฟ้าเหรอ?!?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เหมือนว่า <เซอร์วัล> จะวางขายถุงมือ
ช่างแบบใหม่เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถุงมือที่ซื้อมาจาก <มานาซึรุ> คราวก่อน
หนามากเลย ฉันกำลังหาถุงมือใหม่อยู่พอดี

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เพิ่งสังเกตว่าอุทาฮะสวมถุงมือช่าง
อยู่ตลอดเวลาเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีเหตุผลอะไรงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่มีเหตุผลอะไรเป็นพิเศษหรอก... ก็แค่
นิ้วของฉันไม่ค่อยสวยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มือฉันจับโลหะและน้ำมันมาตั้งแต่เด็กน่ะ
ปลายนิ้วเลยแตก แถมยังมีคราบน้ำมันอีก
ไม่น่าดูหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็เลยสวมถุงมืออยู่ตลอดน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้พอมีเวลาว่างรึเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ครูว่างนะ มีอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พอดีฉันต้องไปซื้ออุปกรณ์นิดหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มันมีร้านอุปกรณ์ที่มีแค่ฉันเท่านั้นที่รู้
อยู่ร้านหนึ่ง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูว่างก็อยากแนะนำร้านนั้นให้
รู้จักน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูว่างเสมอแหละ!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，剛剛看到你很認真地在看文具的型錄……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是有什麼需要的東西嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 想要訂一個新的筆筒

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果是單純的款式的話，在我這裡做的話應該會更快唷。老師你覺得怎麼樣呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這麼簡單就能做出來嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 當然。而且還比市面上賣得更輕更堅固

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 正好我手邊有材料，我來幫你做怎麼樣呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，那就拜託你了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 好的，那希望你大約1小時後到工程師部的工作室來

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，夏萊的廁所好像停電了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就算按了開關，燈也不會亮

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 啊，這樣啊，謝謝你。得叫維修人員來才行……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒問題的，好像只是電線斷掉了而已，應該很好修的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 壓接工具放在哪呢？我來修理

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 夏萊裡沒有那種專業的工具……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……沒有嗎？一個也沒有？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……這樣啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，按照計畫，今天下午會去夏萊值班

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 抱歉，突然有急事，下午我可能不會待在夏萊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這樣啊。不，那也沒辦法

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師不在的時候，有什麼需要幫忙做的事嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 下午可能會有快遞送來，能幫我收一下嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 快遞？會送來什麼呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我訂了一隻機器狗

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘿，是機器狗啊……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……以防萬一跟你說一下，不可以解剖它唷？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……詠葉？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你之前拜託我修理的自行車已經修好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次你來千年時，可以到工程師部這邊來拿嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 好厲害，動作真快

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不愧是千年的巨匠！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘛，就算不是我來做，修起來也不算很難

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師下次自己修修看的話就會知道了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我寧願站在詠葉旁邊看你修理

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這個嘛，怎麼辦才好呢……工作室裡面有很多危險的東西

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 而且，修理也不過是單純作業的反覆操作而已。我覺得不是什麼有趣的事喔

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我會乖乖待著的嘛～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 像個小孩一樣……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不管怎樣，現在手邊也沒有東西需要修理……之後有機會再說吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這麼說來，雷醬剛剛獨自在停車場做著奇怪的動作唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 什麼，雷醬嗎！？！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 「Serval」好像要推出新的工作手套的樣子

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我之前買的「Manaslu」有點太厚了，真是剛好

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這麼說來，詠葉在室內也一直帶著手套呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 是有什麼特別的理由嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實也沒什麼特別的理由，只是因為我的手指沒什麼好看的而已

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 從以前就一直接觸到油或是金屬之類的東西，絕對稱不上好看

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，就是這樣

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天有空嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒問題唷。有什麼事嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想要更新一下工具

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有間我常去的工具專賣店

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師不介意的話，我想介紹給你

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我很樂意！
